$comment: SITE EDIT FILE FOR THE CART PAGE, CHECKOUT FORM AND PAYMENT-RESULT PAGE. Groups run from the top of the cart page downward, then the payment-result page. Inside a group: the words first, then that text's font and font size, then its colour with its opacity on the very next line. Opacity runs from 0 (invisible) to 1 (solid). Colours are six-digit codes like #4b303b. Keep every comma and quotation mark; check the file with a JSON validator before saving. Notes like this one start with $comment and are ignored by the site. Font: 'default' keeps the current look, or type a name from the font list in the README (for example Playfair Display). Font size: 'default', or a size such as 1.5rem or 24px.

basePalette.$comment: BASE COLOURS. Used by anything that does not have its own colour below, including the quantity (+ / -) and Remove buttons. The colour behind the whole page comes from Home.json.

cartHeading.$comment: TOP OF THE CART PAGE. Small label and big title on the left, the Continue shopping button on the right.

continueButton.$comment: CONTINUE SHOPPING BUTTON (same look as the Continue shopping button on the payment-result page). normal = resting, hover = mouse over.

cartItems.$comment: LIST OF ITEMS IN THE CART. The quantity (+ / -) and Remove buttons are not edited here.
cartItems.maxPerItemText: Limit {max} per item. For larger orders,
cartItems.cartUpdatedPrefixText: We updated your cart because stock changed:
cartItems.stockChangedText: Some items changed while you were shopping

orderSummary.$comment: ORDER SUMMARY (right column, or below the items on a phone). From the top: title, Items / Subtotal / Delivery Fee / Tax / Total rows, the form, the Pay button, the note under it. Prices already include VAT, so Tax only says Included. Delivery Fee and Total read the Delivery prompt until a pickup site or a delivery town is chosen.

formColors.$comment: COLOURS OF THE FORM (the boxes, headings and Pickup/Delivery tiles). The wording and the list of boxes are in the 'CHECKOUT FORM' block further down. The State, Town and Pickup dropdowns use the input colours for the closed box and the 'dropdown...' colours for the arrow and the open list.

payButton.$comment: PAY WITH PAYSTACK BUTTON. normal = ready to pay, hover = mouse over, pressed = while starting checkout, disabled = not ready yet (for example no valid email).

orderSummary.noteText: You will be redirected to Paystack to complete your payment.

$comment_checkoutForm: CHECKOUT FORM (customer details, pickup and delivery). Everything between quotation marks can be edited. Keep every comma and quotation mark exactly as they are, and check the file with a JSON validator before saving. The list of towns, states and pickup sites is NOT here: it lives in the backend file DeliveryEdit/areas.json.
$comment_customerFields: FIELDS ABOUT THE BUYER (email is set above). Each { ... } is one box, shown in this order. key = the name the server saves it under: never change the key of 'name' or 'phone'. label = the words above the box. type = text, tel (phone) or textarea. required = true or false. hint = small grey help text (use empty quotes for none). To add a box: copy one { ... }, give it a NEW key made of letters only (for example giftMessage), and it will be saved with the order. To remove a box, delete its whole { ... } (but not 'name' or 'phone', which the server needs). Keep commas between entries, none after the last.

customerFields.label: Phone number
customerFields.hint: We may call or WhatsApp you about your order.

deliveryMethodTitle: How would you like to get your order?
$comment_deliveryMethods: THE TWO CHOICES. Change 'label' and 'description' freely. Never change 'key': it must stay exactly pickup and delivery.
sameAsCustomerLabel: The person receiving the order is me
$comment_addressFields: FIELDS SHOWN WHEN THE CUSTOMER CHOOSES DELIVERY. Same rules as customerFields. required can be true, false, or "local" (required only for towns marked local in DeliveryEdit/areas.json). copyFrom means: when the customer ticks 'the person receiving the order is me', this box is hidden and filled in from the customer box with that key. Keys understood by the server: recipientName, recipientPhone, state, town, neighbourhood, street, landmark, directions. type 'state' and 'town' make the dropdown menus. Any other new key is simply saved with the order.

addressFields.label: Recipient's phone number
addressFields.hint: The rider will call this number.

addressFields.label: Neighbourhood / area
addressFields.hint: Required for local delivery. Strongly recommended everywhere else, it helps the rider find you.

addressFields.label: Landmark
addressFields.hint: Recommended. A well-known place nearby makes delivery much easier.

areasUnavailableMessage: Pickup and delivery options are unavailable right now. Please try again shortly.

emptyCart.$comment: WHAT CUSTOMERS SEE WHEN THE CART IS EMPTY.
emptyCart.headingText: A little space for something lovely.
emptyCart.messageText: Your cart is empty for now. Browse the collection and save the pieces that make you pause.

paymentStatusPage.$comment: THE PAGE CUSTOMERS SEE AFTER PAYING. The space above and below the button is fixed at 3rem in the site style sheet.
paymentStatusPage.messageWhenCheckingText: Please wait, we are confirming your order.
paymentStatusPage.messageWhenPaidText: Thank you! Your payment was successful.
paymentStatusPage.messageWhenFailedText: We couldn't confirm this payment. If you were charged, please contact us so we can help.
paymentStatusPage.messageWhenNotFoundText: We couldn't find an order with that reference.
paymentStatusPage.messageWhenTimedOutText: This is taking longer than expected. Please check back shortly, or contact us with your reference.

continueButton.$comment: CONTINUE SHOPPING BUTTON (same look as the one on the cart page). normal = resting, hover = mouse over.
